title: Cline
intro: Cline's CLI in JSON mode on an OpenAI-compatible provider (DeepSeek's OpenAI endpoint by default). Text, reasoning and tool content become items as each piece ends.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek's OpenAI endpoint; the second turn did not recall the first (--id resumes only in interactive mode in 3.0.73)

notes: The provider is OpenAI-compatible (api: openai-chat); Cline's providers.json is written every turn with the gateway URL and the model.

Cline's --id is documented to resume a session, but the 3.0.73 source honours it only in interactive mode: a continuation keeps the workspace and the home, and the agent's own memory of earlier turns may not carry.
--auto-approve true is used rather than -y: -y runs a reduced tool set and disables hooks.
